rules.purpose: Adapt exact preseal and independent-ended source closure schema; keep prerequisite pin separate
rules.from: async function checkedPreseal(expectedSha){const file=path.join(base,'compact-wire-formal10-preseal-input-check-v6.json'),p=await pin(file);assert.equal(p.sha256,expectedSha);const value=await read(file);assert.equal(value.root,root);assert.equal(value.driverSourceCommit,'4cab00893b861395b63906b1b8183a021d397cdb');assert.equal(value.coreCodeEvidenceCommit,'6d70d02d0bc390156b77a3e48acee714fc87cda3');assert.equal(value.coreDriverSourceSha256,'05c07c2e487e4b65c5068f8803f96bdc6a66a342c5fc44c21f3a64b6b8581073');assert.equal(value.syntax.passed,true);assert.equal(value.reviewedFiles.length,47);assert.equal(sha(JSON.stringify(value.reviewedFiles)),value.reviewedSourceSha256);assert.deepEqual(await pin(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),value.rootSealExecutor);for(const entry of[...value.reviewedFiles,...value.wireSourceFiles])assert.deepEqual(await pin(entry.file),entry);assert.deepEqual(await pin(value.executionPrerequisites.file),value.executionPrerequisites);const prerequisites=await read(value.executionPrerequisites.file);for(const entry of prerequisites.files)assert.deepEqual(await pin(entry.file),entry);return{value,pin:p,prerequisites};}
